configurations.name: mitra-worktree
runtimeArgs: const { readdirSync, statSync, existsSync } = await import('node:fs'); const { join } = await import('node:path'); const { pathToFileURL } = await import('node:url'); const root = '.claude/worktrees'; const newest = dir => Math.max(0, ...readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true }).filter(entry => entry.isFile()).map(entry => statSync(join(entry.parentPath, entry.name)).mtimeMs)); const worktrees = existsSync(root) ? readdirSync(root).filter(name => existsSync(join(root, name, 'scripts', 'dev.ts'))) : []; const chosen = process.env.MITRA_WORKTREE || worktrees.map(name => ({ name, changed: newest(join(root, name, 'src')) })).sort((a, b) => b.changed - a.changed)[0]?.name; if (chosen) process.chdir(join(root, chosen)); process.env.MITRA_PORT = process.env.PORT || '3248'; console.log('Running Mitra from ' + process.cwd() + ' on port ' + process.env.MITRA_PORT); await import(pathToFileURL('scripts/dev.ts').href)
